name: Creel Fisher Mairi

intro.text: Creels are the pots we set for lobsters, crab and langoustine. We bring them up before sunrise. You're standing on my bait.

win: Right enough. I'll buy you a scallop.
after: The langoustine is pink, the size of a hand and the nicest thing in the sea. The scallop comes second. The crab will tell you it is first.
